stances.summary: Attributes Black qualification doubts to racism, not DEI
stances.quote: DEI is not the reason why you presume Black people aren’t qualified. Racism is the reason. And a need to believe a Black person could not possibly do better than you. I know it and you know it, too.

stances.summary: Calls race-based pilot criticism standard racism
stances.quote: Let’s look at the race of the pilots of every U.S. flight that has ever crashed and then call this what it is: unabashed, standard-issue, racism.

stances.summary: Identifies Black Americans as greatest democracy advocates
stances.quote: Once again, it is Black people who are the greatest agents of democracy the United States has ever seen.

stances.summary: Criticizes media for racial double standard in crisis coverage
stances.quote: Why would a journalist even ask this question? When was the last time journalists asked a white governor if a catastrophe happened because too many white people were hired? This is how racial propaganda works. Media should not legitimize it.

stances.summary: Demands media label mass violence as racist violence, not just racially motivated
stances.quote: Journalists: the Jacksonville mass murder was not racially motivated violence, it was RACIST violence. We must be specific and direct with our language.

stances.summary: Praises real-time journalist fact-checking of political claims
stances.quote: A model, in many ways, for how journalists in real time should be forcing politicians to back up their claims with facts and sources and not simply allowing them to go unchallenged.

stances.quote: You can’t even get basic facts right, like that I am not a former NYT reporter. I just published a big essay for the magazine I work for last week. I’ve corrected you on this before.

stances.summary: Praises moderators for real-time fact-checking during debate
stances.quote: Shout out to the @ABC moderators for fact-checking in real time. This is how you do it.

stances.summary: Identifies Harris criticism as racist dog whistle
stances.quote: Kellyanne Conway just said on Fox News that Kamala Harris doesn’t speak well or work hard — rich considering who she worked for, and laughable because we’ve all heard the VP speak. The racist dog whistles have begun.

stances.summary: Criticizes media double standard on Trump's fitness for office
stances.quote: Trump has been caught sleeping several times at the convention, which apparently is not a crisis or a sign that he’s too old to serve.

stances.summary: Reports Black Americans feel underheard in Democratic Party

stances.summary: Warns democracy is in decline
stances.quote: We are in dangerous, dangerous times. A faltering democracy in decline.

stances.summary: Criticizes Black Republican candidates distancing from ancestors
stances.quote: Imagine being Black and running in a political party where you believe you need to disgrace your ancestors to have a chance.

stances.summary: Argues all children deserve educational opportunity regardless of pace
stances.quote: This is for all the people who dismiss the need for opportunity for anyone except our top students. All of our children have potential, talent and worth. We don’t throw away the ones who blossom late.

stances.summary: Condemns Florida schools requiring permission slips for Black authors
stances.quote: Y’all. There’s no illusion anymore. Kids in the diverse Miami-Dade school system in Florida having to sign permission slips to be read to from a book because it’s  “by an African American.”

stances.summary: Contradicts DEI-blaming for Black student under-enrollment without affirmative action
stances.quote: UC does not have affirmative action, Black students remain under-enrolled. Blaming Black folks, however, never goes out of style.

stances.summary: Confirms CRT bans are anti-Black history laws as predicted
stances.quote: Remember when we were told they weren't opposing the teaching of Black history, just "CRT"? And how many dismissed those of us who said these laws were anti-history laws, and anti-Black? Perhaps one day folks will listen to those who know. https://t.co/LnBhTYcMsZ

stances.summary: Explains student loan forgiveness addresses compounding interest, not irresponsibility
stances.quote: Because clearly it still needs to be said: Student loan forgiveness is not about irresponsible people taking out education loans and then not paying. These are compounding interest loans: borrowers are struggling because they pay many times OVER what they borrowed and still owe!

stances.summary: Criticizes poor state's rejection of federal child nutrition aid
stances.quote: The cruelty of being the poorest state in America and choosing — choosing — to turn down federal aid for poor children to eat.

stances.summary: Contextualizes Montgomery's Black mayor as significant given slavery history
stances.quote: If you understand the history of Montgomery -- one of the most prolific slave-trading cities in the US turned brutally repressive apartheid regime after, and majority Black but JUST got its first Black mayor -- it gives so much more perspective to this video. Trust.

stances.summary: Argues billionaire taxation should fund universal college
stances.quote: If billionaires paid their fair share of taxes we wouldn’t have to rely on these “gifts” bestowed on a few and instead could offer universal college. Just saying.

stances.summary: Reframes Civil Rights sit-ins as civil disobedience against unjust laws

stances.summary: Links gun violence and lack of accountability to liberal tolerance
stances.quote: He shot this 60-year-old woman three times. This is the result of a society with too many guns and too little tolerance and the certainty that the law will protect you for shooting first.

stances.summary: Condemns busing asylum seekers to cities as inhumane political stunt
stances.quote: Imagine being in a foreign country, not speaking the language, desperate and with your child, and being dropped off in the middle of the street in a strange city with nothing because a politician wants to stoke the ugliest instincts of humanity. American exceptionalism indeed.
